columns.text: Rates Key Employment Indicators: April 2005 to August 2026

notes: 1. Details may not add up to totals due to rounding.
2. Estimates for April 2005 to January 2016 adopted the 2000-based Population Projections.
3. Estimates for April 2016 to October 2018 adopted the 2010-based Population Projections.
4. Estimates for January 2019 to December 2025 adopted the 2015-based Population Projections.
5. Starting January 2026, the 2020 Census of Population and Housing Population Projections was used.

6. Starting April 2005, the new unemployment definition was adopted per NSCB Resolution no. 15 dated October 20, 2004. As indicated in the said resolution, the unemployed include all persons who are 15 years old and over as of their last birthday and are reported as (1) without work; AND (2) currently available for work; AND (3) seeking work OR not seeking work due to valid reasons.
7. Calculation of the October 2013 estimates includes data from the Province of Leyte.

8. Region VIII was not covered in the January 2014 LFS due to the effects of Typhoon Yolanda. The province of Leyte was not covered from the April, July, and October 2014 rounds and from the January and April 2015 rounds because a new sampling frame had to be developed following widespread household displacement caused by Typhoon Yolanda. Consequently, the 2014 annual estimates exclude Leyte and are based on the average of three quarter-rounds (April, July, and October), while the 2015 annual estimates likewise exclude Leyte in Region VIII.

9. Starting 2021, the Labor Force Survey is conducted monthly. However, the regular LFS rounds (January, April, July and October rounds) can provide reliable estimates at the regional level while the Special LFS rounds (February, March, May, June, August, September, November and December rounds) can only provide reliable estimate at the national level.

10. The methodology for the computation of annual estimates of labor and employment indicators is based on the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) Board Resolution No. 14 Series of 2021 - Adopting the General Method for Annualized Estimates for the Labor Force Survey 2021 and Beyond.
11. The Annual 2025 is based on the official release last March 19, 2026 and is computed based on the preliminary estimates from January 2025 to December 2025.
12. Estimates from April 2005 to August 2025 were final.
13. Estimates from September 2025 to August 2026 were preliminary and may change.
